blocker.failure_log_summary: Two registered-state verifier failures were corrected: the first rejected the stale pre-registration state because blocker.active was true while blocker.class was null; the second rejected references to ident-01, settings-configuration, and system-service-ipc because those IDs are not registered. The blocker was cleared and cross_workstream_dependencies was restricted to registered IDs; the final ./nagi dev verify passes for 19 workstreams and 12 state files including notify-01. Initial Cargo attempts selected x86_64 Homebrew Rust tools from /usr/local/bin on an arm64 host and mixed rustdoc/Clippy toolchains; explicitly selecting the repository-pinned arm64 nightly toolchain resolved the environment issue. An initial format check caught only formatting introduced by the new malformed-action acceptance test; cargo fmt fixed it and the subsequent check passes. No implementation test failure remains.
attempted_fixes: Removed public service getters that exposed persistence and adapter internals and could bypass profile-scoped service APIs; tests observe state through their fixture.
Reject generation advancement at u64::MAX instead of saturating and reusing a persistence revision; in-memory compare-and-swap also uses checked_add(1).
Use saturating byte aggregation for snapshots and total in-memory store usage so accumulated sizes cannot wrap below quota checks.
Rate-limit diagnostic sink attempts to 128 per 1,000 monotonic milliseconds, track dropped events internally, and report a process-level summary at the next available window.
Added explicit malformed action descriptor acceptance coverage for invalid action IDs, duplicate parameter names, excessive parameter count, and descriptor byte limits.
